scope: Uploaded LIVRAISON_eSonde_v6.zip and its extracted source tree only; no data generated or corrected.

eSonde_v6_checkpoint.checkpoint_policy: symmetric within-text co-occurrence; prompt and response processed independently; no pair lookup table
eSonde_v6_checkpoint.finding: No parametric conditional prompt-to-response training objective is preserved in the delivered V6 checkpoint.

eGenBrain_v4_loader.split_policy: deterministic 80/10/10 grouping by canonical task+prompt group; stable hash order; same prompt group kept in one split

task_policy.math_qa: eligible as a distinct Q/A domain within the chat interface; report separately
task_policy.sms_classification: exclude from chat training and chat evaluation

eGenBrain_v4_loader.scope_warning: The 7,473 math_qa pairs are not general conversation data. Their presence does not change the V6 checkpoint finding or establish French dialogue supervision.

data_policy_for_v7.inference_memory: forbidden; no prompt/answer table, nearest-neighbour answer retrieval, or raw-answer datastore at inference
data_policy_for_v7.training: conditional parameters may be learned from TRAIN pairs only; validation for model selection; test held out until final reporting
data_policy_for_v7.text_only: may support a separately logged next-token/language regularization objective; never contribute assistant-role response-start statistics unless role provenance is explicit
data_policy_for_v7.grouping: all identical canonical prompts across source files must share one split; exact duplicate pairs retain provenance and multiplicity but do not create independent examples
data_policy_for_v7.v6_checkpoint: read-only and immutable; new learned V7 parameters must be stored in a separately versioned derived checkpoint
